mapper.sql: u.user_id, u.user_nm, u.password_hash, u.role_cd, u.use_yn, u.lock_yn, u.fail_cnt, u.last_login_dt, u.last_login_ip, u.appr_status, u.email, u.dept_nm, u.req_reason, u.appr_user, u.appr_dt, u.reject_reason, u.reg_dt
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_user SET fail_cnt = 0, last_login_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_login_ip = #{clientIp}, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE tb_user SET lock_yn = CASE WHEN fail_cnt + 1 >= #{maxFail} THEN 'Y' ELSE lock_yn END, fail_cnt = fail_cnt + 1, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_login_hist (user_id, login_dt, client_ip, result_cd, message) VALUES (#{userId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{clientIp}, #{resultCd}, #{message})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, fail_cnt = 0, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_user ( user_id, user_nm, password_hash, role_cd, use_yn, lock_yn, fail_cnt, appr_status, email, dept_nm, req_reason, reg_dt, upd_dt ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userNm}, #{passwordHash}, 'USER', 'Y', 'N', 0, 'PENDING', #{email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deptNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reqReason}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user u WHERE u.appr_status = 'PENDING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_user u WHERE u.role_cd = 'ADMIN' AND u.use_yn = 'Y' AND u.lock_yn = 'N' AND u.appr_status = 'APPROVED'
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_user SET appr_status = 'APPROVED', role_cd = #{roleCd}, appr_user = #{apprUser}, appr_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, reject_reason = NULL, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND appr_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE tb_user SET appr_status = 'REJECTED', appr_user = #{apprUser}, appr_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND appr_status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE tb_user SET lock_yn = 'N', fail_cnt = 0, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE tb_user SET use_yn = #{useYn}, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE tb_user SET role_cd = #{roleCd}, upd_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND appr_status = 'APPROVED'
